items: TIMELESS VINTAGE OVAL DESIGN：The VAVC small gold watches for women showcases a classic and elegant oval shape with surface golden Roman font, making it one of the most stylish gold watches for women that enhances both casual and formal outfits

DURABLE AND RELIABLE：The watch is equipped with a high-quality quartz movement to ensure accurate timekeeping. Whether it's washing your hands or just a light drizzle, this durable watch can withstand everyday activities - perfect for those looking for a reliable women's gold watch
